verdict.rationale: Modal repeatedly markets Sandboxes as 'secure, isolated' environments for running untrusted/agent code, and has dedicated docs on 'Networking and security' and a 'VM Sandboxes' feature, plus network-allowlist controls (block_network, outbound/inbound CIDR) suggesting real isolation controls. However, the pack shows only a 'Beta' VM Sandboxes label without technical detail on the isolation mechanism (e.g., no explicit microVM/Firecracker/gVisor documentation), and default sandboxes are described as 'secure containers' rather than a clearly documented hard boundary. Missing for 10: explicit technical documentation naming the isolation technology (microVM/gVisor/etc.) as the default guarantee, independent security audit or hands-on validation of the boundary, and clarity on whether VM-level isolation is standard vs. beta-only.
